description: Estimates how much a UK business could save a year by handing admin to AI: a range in pounds from team size, weekly admin hours per person, hourly pay (default the ONS 2025 UK median) and sector exposure (Department for Education ranking), with two or three insights. Partial by design: the free AI audit gives the full breakdown. Free, no key. Docs: https://aeolookup.com/ai-calculators/ai-savings-calculator/

admin_hours.description: Hours of admin each person does a week (default 10).

hourly_pay.description: Average hourly pay in pounds (default 19.67, the UK median).

name: calculate_ai_savings
title: AI savings calculator
